title: Daily Examen
description: Ignatian review of your day before God · ~7 min (evenings)

glory_be.text:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.
glory_be.latin:
Gloria Patri, et Filio,
et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio,
et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

examen_1.text:
Place yourself in God's presence.
Give thanks for God's great love for you.
examen_1.source: St. Ignatius of Loyola, Spiritual Exercises

examen_2.text: Pray for the grace to understand how God is acting in your life.
examen_2.source: St. Ignatius of Loyola, Spiritual Exercises

examen_3.text:
Review your day — recall specific moments and your feelings at the time.
Where was God present? Where did you resist God's grace?
examen_3.source: St. Ignatius of Loyola, Spiritual Exercises

examen_4.text:
Reflect on what you did, said, or thought in those moments.
Were you drawing closer to God, or further away?
examen_4.source: St. Ignatius of Loyola, Spiritual Exercises

examen_5.text:
Look toward tomorrow — ask for God's help and guidance.
Resolve to grow in holiness.
examen_5.source: St. Ignatius of Loyola, Spiritual Exercises
